Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression redundantly combines two time expressions; use the single time expression for a historical setting.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，use a location phrase after the verb with “住在”; the ongoing state of living somewhere does not need “了”.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，“跟” presents the mother and child as equal co-participants, while “带着” accurately shows that the mother takes her young child with her.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，place “了” after the directional/resultative complement “到” to mark the completed move.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，“另一个” is the standard expression for “another” one; “别一个” does not fit here.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，first mention should introduce a character with an identifying noun phrase, rather than assuming the reader already knows who the named characters are.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when “孟子” was named in the previous sentence and no other male character competes as the referent.
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在一个城市里，first mention of a place should use an indefinite noun phrase; “那个” incorrectly assumes that this city has already been introduced.
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，after “孟母” has just been named and no other woman is present, use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，remove “了” because “每天” describes a habitual routine, which takes the zero aspect marker.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines a historical-time expression with “的时候”; “在古代” is correct.
“住了在” has incorrect placement of 了, and “住在靠近墓地的家里” is a correct location expression.
“跟孩子搬家” is grammatical and can correctly mean that the mother moved together with her child.
With the directional complement 到, completed movement is expressed as “搬到了,” not “搬了到.”
“别一个城市” is not appropriate for another city here; “另一个城市” is correct.
The first mention should introduce 孟子 rather than merely assume the reader knows him, but the proposed replacement ends with the incomplete phrase “他和妈妈.”
“孩子” is vague here, while “他” clearly refers back to the recently introduced 孟子.
The city has not previously been introduced, so a first mention should use “一个城市” rather than “那个城市.”
孟母 has just been mentioned and no competing female referent exists, so “她” is the required close re-reference.
“每天” describes a habitual action, so “祭拜” takes no perfective 了.
